title: Add a text contrast check for placeholders and secondary text
summary: Add CHK-023 (text contrast at least 4.5:1 for body, placeholder and secondary text, 3:1 for large text and icons) to the check rules, and a token decision for --text-3 placeholders. Draft only: the owner decides whether the floor is 4.5:1 for placeholders and whether --text-3 is lightened or placeholders move to --text-2.

positive.description: Placeholder text in --text-2 on --s2 (6.34:1), or a lighter --text-3 that reaches 4.5:1.

validation.notes: Run npm run regression with the candidate bundle before submitting. Expect the 12 reference apps to show placeholder contrast failures until their placeholder tokens are updated by the owner's decision.

existingApplications.note: Existing applications are not changed by this proposal. Their records keep guidance 0.1.0 until the owner decides to update them.
